title: Blitch backs Randy Anderson's Crane story after Grusch introduction
summary: John Blitch tells of Blitch backs Randy Anderson's Crane story after Grusch introduction, about unspecified at Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

tellings.quote: uh I I I believe every aspect of his story

plain: A scientist named John Blitch, who worked with DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a man named Randy Anderson and his story about Crane, a Navy weapons research base in Indiana. Blitch says that he met Anderson through David Grusch, a former intelligence official turned whistleblower, and that he believes every part of Anderson's story. If true, a serious scientist is vouching for an account of strange events at a military site.
